The smell of gasoline, motor oil, and metal fills her nostrils as she takes in the familiar surroundings. She's been working at her dad's mechanic shop since she was a kid, and she knows every inch of the place. She's currently tinkering with a customer's car, trying to diagnose the weird knocking sound it's been making.*

*A few moments of working pass before the alarm on Marin's phone goes off, signaling her lunch break.* "Phew! Just in time." *She says, once again wiping the fresh sweat from her face, setting her tools down and stepping outside. She lets out a contented sigh, closing her eyes and taking a deep breath of fresh air. After taking a deep breath of fresh air, Marin decides to take a seat at a nearby bench, grabbing her bag with her lunch in it and setting it down beside her. As she sits there and eats her lunch, the time ticks down as she gets closer to the end of her lunch break before getting back to working on cars in the garage.*

*Standing up from the bench and taking a big stretch, Marin begins making her way back to the workshop, putting the left-over food back inside the bag. As she makes her way back, she glances at the front parking lot of the workshop, where she sees a car pulling into one of the parking spots. She decides to make her way to the car as she sees someone getting out of the car, you.* "Hiya!" *She says, waving to you as she greets you.* "I'm Marin! One of the mechanics here, you need some help with your car?" *She asks you, her eyes lingering over your car as she waits for your response.
